shortDescription: To perform a component firmware rollback using component name

options.name: baseuri
options.description: IP address of the target out-of-band controller. For example- <ipaddress>:<port>.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: name
options.description: The name or regular expression of the component to match and is case-sensitive. The Name should be a supported rollback component. To view the list of rollback components for iDRAC9 and above, see, U(https://I(idrac_ip)/redfish/v1/UpdateService/FirmwareInventory?$expand=*($levels=1)'

options.name: password
options.description: Password of the target out-of-band controller. If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export IDRAC_PASSWORD=password

options.name: reboot
options.description: Reboot the server to apply the previous version of the firmware. C(true) reboots the server to rollback the firmware to the available version. C(false) schedules the rollback of firmware until the next restart. When I(reboot) is C(false), some components update immediately, and the server may reboot. So, the module must wait till the server is accessible.

options.name: reboot_timeout
options.description: Wait time in seconds. The module waits for this duration till the server reboots.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: Username of the target out-of-band controller. If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_USERNAME) is used. Example: export IDRAC_USERNAME=username

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used. Prior to collection version C(5.0.0), the I(validate_certs) is C(false) by default.

options.name: x_auth_token
options.description: Authentication token. If the x_auth_token is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_X_AUTH_TOKEN) is used. Example: export IDRAC_X_AUTH_TOKEN=x_auth_token
